title: Acute chest pain with shortness of breath
text: Patient reports severe chest pressure radiating to left arm and sweating.
action: Immediate emergency escalation, ECG within 10 minutes, and cardiac markers

title: ECG ST-segment change
text: ECG indicates ST elevation and possible myocardial ischemia.
action: Activate cardiac emergency pathway and urgent cardiology intervention

title: Mild palpitations episode
text: Intermittent palpitations without chest pain or syncope.
action: Outpatient rhythm evaluation and monitor for red-flag symptoms

title: Hypertension follow-up
text: Routine blood pressure review, no emergency symptoms.
action: Continue routine management and medication adherence counseling

title: Tooth abscess with swelling
text: Localized gum swelling and severe molar pain with pus pocket.
action: Urgent dental drainage review and antibiotic/pain management

title: Routine scaling appointment
text: Patient scheduled for non-urgent dental cleaning.
action: Proceed with scheduled cleaning and oral hygiene counseling

title: Wisdom tooth impaction
text: Jaw pain and chewing discomfort associated with impacted wisdom tooth.
action: Dental imaging and extraction planning with interim analgesia

title: Orthodontic retainer adjustment
text: Minor discomfort due to retainer fit; no infection signs.
action: Non-urgent orthodontic adjustment and fit correction

title: Fever with body ache
text: Persistent fever above 101 F with fatigue and body aches.
action: General physician review, hydration, and infection-focused workup

title: Seasonal cough and sore throat
text: Dry cough and sore throat for three days, no breathing distress.
action: Symptomatic treatment and observe for respiratory red flags

title: Mild headache from dehydration
text: Headache improves with hydration and rest.
action: Oral rehydration, rest, and reassess if symptoms persist

title: Post-vaccination low-grade fever
text: Mild fever after vaccination, stable vitals and no red flags.
action: Supportive care with antipyretics and return precautions

title: Skin rash from detergent
text: Localized rash after new detergent exposure, no airway compromise.
action: Avoid trigger, start topical care, and monitor for systemic allergy signs

title: Travel medication refill request
text: Administrative refill request before travel; no active symptoms.
action: Process refill per protocol and provide adherence/travel guidance
